Corpus

Three separate input sets, with different tasks and evidence status.

Synthetic means written for the experiment. Public documents come from an external issuing body. Neither category is automatically independent test material or a validated reference answer.

Evidence status

Published observations are maintainer-led tests with provisional labels and automated advisory review. Independent human adjudication and validation are pending. No qualified quality ranking or PALO Blueprint Index is assigned.

Policy Interpretation

Input
3 short fictional procurement texts
Task
Source-linked translation and statement verification
Models
18 configurations across retained collection groups
Repetitions
3 per assigned task
Execution
OpenRouter API; serving provider in receipts

The texts describe invoice matching, purchase approval and vendor onboarding. Together they contain 36 source rules and 108 candidate statements. All were authored within the development process. This is one authoring provenance group, not three independently sourced organisations.

Model results and configuration roster · Source texts and provisional labels on GitHub

Process Interpretation

Input
6 fictional process descriptions
Task
48 propositions, 6 workflow tasks and 7 paired variations
Models
3 configurations: OpenAI, Anthropic and Google
Repetitions
1 per assigned task
Execution
60 requests through OpenRouter API

The process descriptions introduce exceptions, scope conditions, dependencies and conflicting interpretations. They share one automated authoring provenance group. The source bank is exposed development material; its labels await human adjudication.

  • Emergency spare-parts purchasing8 propositions
  • Framework call-offs and aggregation8 propositions
  • Supplier bank change and emergency payment8 propositions
  • Effective dates and unresolved policy conflict8 propositions
  • Currency conversion and approval ownership8 propositions
  • Milestone acceptance, partial completion and clocks8 propositions

Results, exact source packets and advisory notes · Source bank on GitHub

Specification Generation

Input
3 public procurement documents; 200 supplied pages
Task
Generate a structured specification from source documents
Models
3 configurations; see the study page
Repetitions
3 planned repetitions per input and configuration
Execution
OpenRouter API through MCP; status on the study page

This study uses externally issued documents rather than fictional source text. The document register records editions, URLs, retained bytes, extraction coverage and reuse conditions. Its generated outputs require source-based human review; public availability does not make a reference answer independent or complete.

Document inventory, execution status and generated outputs

Adapter diagnostics

Input
3 short excerpts from public documents, 4,994 UTF-8 bytes
Task
Historical PALO extraction-contract checks
Models
10 historical configurations
Repetitions
1 assigned call per excerpt
Execution
Historical API records; incomplete and differing configurations

These excerpts concern planning documents and aircraft weighing. They are not the three synthetic procurement texts described above. Their structural acceptance counts diagnose adapter behaviour; they do not measure semantic quality or demonstrate processing of the larger source repositories.

Reference answers and review

Current synthetic labels are provisional, including the disputed P002, P013 and P036 items. Automated advisory responses are retained separately from human annotation templates. Changes made after observing a response do not silently redefine the original result.
